{{Quote|Civilians, what a distasteful word. Bring me some of this rabble holed up in their homes and I'll give you a proper fighting force. We'll show these Tusken savages what war is about.|Major Berok Skoff|<ref name="SWG:TA" />}}
'''Berok Skoff''' was [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa's]] combat guild hall [[Major/Legends|major]] and [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|All right, the first squad of your new militia will arrive soon.|Major Berok Skoff|<ref name="SWG:TA" />}}
He was a leading member in the [[Mos Espa Militia]] and a key figure in the [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|Battle of Mos Espa]]. He would wear [[Crusader Mark III armor|Mark III]] [[Crusader armor]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Berok Skoff was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Berok Skoff was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Tusken Army|"Tusken Army" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:TA" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
